node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one cubic three-double affine-invariant formula
node.statement: The depressed-cubic invariants of the three-double value map have the closed formulas (AIF5). The seven m=8 affine color values therefore split into four explicit rational homogeneous factors, and each generic branch is a rational system in (x,q,d) after eliminating b.
node.notes: Exact formula and packet compiler only. Four rational factors represent seven geometric color values; no unit verdict, base-field color assignment, or outer/inner packet witness is claimed.
